newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan M-2 up 1.45 percent in week to Aug 16.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan M-2 up 1.45 percent in week to Aug 16.

text.p: Venezuelan money supply, as measured by the monetary aggregate M-2, rose 1.45 percent to 4.311 trillion bolivars in the week to August 16, the central bank said.
At the beginning of 1996, M-2 was 3.530 trillion bolivars.
The monetary base, meanwhile, fell 8.11 percent, or 93 billion bolivars, to 1.054 trillion bolivars in the week.
At the beginning of 1996, base money stood at 873 billion bolivars.
